shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright slab/pillar
animals or creature heads in profile
a row of repeated small units along the upper edge (row of squarish signs/motifs)
narrow raised border framing the relief field
a small figure with raised/bent arms
justification: Both are tall upright slabs bearing low-relief imagery organised in stacked vertical registers with a row of repeated small squarish units along the top edge and animal/bird heads in profile, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is sparse and schematic, with isolated stick-like quadrupeds, a bird and a large snake set against blank ground, whereas B is a dense, horror-vacui composition dominated by a single elaborately costumed anthropomorphic figure with headdress, ornaments and glyph-like blocks packed around it — quite different subject matter and conventions of rendering.
